'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Rasmus DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rasmus]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Rasmus]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Username:''' Twotak
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
